passages.title: 睡在樓梯上的貓
passages.text: Our cat Mochi has a strange favorite place. She doesn't sleep on her soft bed or on the sofa in the {1} room. She sleeps on the {2}! Every night, she lies on the third step, right in the middle. One evening, Dad came down with a big basket of clothes. He couldn't see Mochi, and he almost stepped on her. He jumped, and all the clothes fell on the {3}. Mochi just opened one eye and went back to sleep. Dad was {4} at first, but then he laughed. The next day, he put a small cat bed on the third step and a sign on the {5} above it: "Careful! Cat sleeping." Now everyone in our family walks around her bed slowly, and Mochi is happier than ever.

blanks.why: living room「客廳」：沙發放在客廳。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
sleep on the stairs「睡在樓梯上」，後面說她躺在第三階。coughs、fevers、soups 都沒有階梯。
fall on the floor「掉到地上」：衣服全掉到地板上。cough、fever、lemon 都不能讓衣服掉在上面。
be mad at…「對…生氣」：差點被絆倒很生氣。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
a sign on the wall「牆上的告示」。cough、soup、toe 都不能貼告示。

passages.zh: 我們家的貓麻糬有個奇怪的最愛地點。她不睡在她軟軟的床上，也不睡在客廳的沙發上，而是睡在樓梯上！每天晚上，她都躺在第三階的正中間。有一天晚上，爸爸抱著一大籃衣服下樓，他沒看到麻糬，差點踩到她。他嚇得跳了起來，衣服全都掉到地上。麻糬只張開一隻眼睛看看，又繼續睡。爸爸一開始很生氣，後來卻笑了。隔天，他在第三階放了一張小貓床，並在上方的牆上貼了一張告示：「小心！貓咪睡覺中。」現在我們全家經過她的床時都會放慢腳步，麻糬也比以前更快樂了。

passages.title: 外婆家不穿鞋的規矩
passages.text: My friend Jake from Canada came to Taiwan last winter. One day, I took him to my grandma's apartment. As soon as he walked in, Grandma pointed at his shoes. "Take them off, please," I told him. "In Taiwan, many families don't wear shoes inside." Jake was surprised, but he put his shoes by the door. Grandma's {1} was so clean that it was shining. We sat on the sofa in the {2} room and drank tea. On the {3}, there were many old family photos, and Jake asked about each one. Then Grandma called us to the {4} table. She had cooked six dishes for us! Jake tried everything and said, "Now I know why you take off your shoes. You need room for all this food!" Grandma didn't understand English, but she looked very {5} anyway.

blanks.why: Grandma's floor was so clean「外婆家的地板乾淨到發亮」。cough、fever、lemon 都不能說「乾淨到發亮」讓人光腳走。
the living room「客廳」：坐在沙發上喝茶。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
photos on the wall「牆上的照片」。soup、cough、toe 都不能掛照片。
the dining table「餐桌」：外婆叫我們去吃飯。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 table 組成「吃飯的桌子」。
look satisfied「看起來很滿意」：客人把菜都吃了。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字，不能形容外婆的樣子。

passages.zh: 我加拿大的朋友 Jake 去年冬天來台灣。有一天，我帶他去外婆的公寓。他一走進去，外婆就指著他的鞋子。「請把鞋子脫掉，」我跟他說，「在台灣，很多家庭在家裡不穿鞋。」Jake 很驚訝，但還是把鞋子放在門邊。外婆家的地板乾淨得發亮。我們坐在客廳的沙發上喝茶。牆上有很多老家族照片，Jake 每一張都問。接著外婆叫我們到餐桌吃飯，她煮了六道菜！Jake 每道都吃了，然後說：「現在我知道你們為什麼要脫鞋了，要留空間給這麼多食物！」外婆聽不懂英文，但看起來還是非常滿意。

passages.title: 牆上的獎狀
passages.text: In our {1} room, there is a big {2} full of my brother's awards. He won first place in a math contest, a speech contest, and even a swimming race. My name was not on any of them. Every time guests came, they looked at the wall and said, "Your brother is amazing!" I always felt a little {3}. This year, I joined the school art club. I painted a picture of our {4} with our dog sleeping on them, and I sent it to a city art contest. Last week, my teacher called my name in class. I had won second place! When I got home, Dad took down one of my brother's awards and put mine in the middle of the wall. My brother smiled and said, "It looks better there." Now I walk past that wall every day with my head up, and my painting hangs over the {5} lamp next to it.

blanks.why: the living room「客廳」：獎狀掛在客廳。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
a big wall full of awards「掛滿獎狀的一面大牆」。soup、fever、toe 都不能掛獎狀。
feel sad「覺得難過」：沒有自己的獎狀。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
a picture of our stairs「我們家樓梯的畫」，狗睡在上面。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能讓狗睡在上面。
floor lamp「落地燈」：floor 放在 lamp 前面表示「放在地上的」。cough、lemon、throat 都不能和 lamp 組成這種燈。

passages.zh: 我們家客廳有一面大牆，掛滿了哥哥的獎狀。他拿過數學比賽、演講比賽，甚至游泳比賽的第一名，但上面沒有一張寫著我的名字。每次客人來，看到那面牆都會說：「你哥哥好厲害！」我總覺得有點難過。今年我參加了學校的美術社。我畫了一幅我們家的樓梯，上面睡著我們家的狗，並拿去參加市內的美術比賽。上星期，老師在課堂上叫我的名字，我得了第二名！我回家後，爸爸拿下哥哥的一張獎狀，把我的掛在牆的正中間。哥哥笑著說：「放那裡比較好看。」現在我每天都抬頭挺胸地走過那面牆，我的畫就掛在旁邊的落地燈上方。

passages.title: 放下手機的晚餐
passages.text: Every evening, my family used to eat dinner at the {1} table without saying a word. Dad read the news on his phone, Mom answered messages, and my sister watched videos. I looked at the clock on the {2} and waited for dinner to end. One day, Grandma came to visit. She saw us and shook her head. After dinner, she put a basket on the {3} next to the table. "From now on, all phones go in here during meals," she said. At first, everyone was {4}. But soon we started to talk. Dad told funny stories about his job, and my sister told us about her new friends. Now, even after Grandma went home, we still put our phones in the basket. Dinner is my favorite time of the day, and we often stay in the {5} room for an hour after eating.

blanks.why: the dining table「餐桌」。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 table 組成吃飯用的桌子。
the clock on the wall「牆上的時鐘」。cough、soup、toe 上面不會掛時鐘。
put a basket on the floor「把籃子放在地上」。fever、lemon、cough 都不能放籃子在上面。
be upset「不高興」：不能用手機大家都不開心。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
the dining room「飯廳」：吃完飯還待在飯廳聊天。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。

passages.zh: 以前每天晚上，我們家都在餐桌吃晚餐，卻一句話也不說。爸爸用手機看新聞，媽媽回訊息，姐姐看影片。我看著牆上的時鐘，等晚餐結束。有一天，外婆來我們家，看到我們這樣就搖了搖頭。晚餐後，她在餐桌旁的地上放了一個籃子。「從現在開始，吃飯時手機都要放進這裡。」她說。一開始大家都很不高興，但很快地我們就開始聊天了。爸爸說了工作上的好笑故事，姐姐告訴我們她的新朋友。現在，即使外婆已經回家了，我們還是會把手機放進籃子。晚餐成了我一天中最喜歡的時光，我們吃完常常還在飯廳待上一個小時。

passages.title: 踩到樂高的夜晚
passages.text: My little brother loves Lego. Every day, he builds castles, cars, and spaceships on the {1} room floor. Mom always tells him to put the pieces away, but he often forgets. Last night, I woke up at midnight and wanted some water. I walked down the {2} in the dark. When I reached the bottom, I stepped on something small and sharp. "Ouch!" I shouted and fell onto the {3}. It was a Lego piece! My foot was in so much {4} that I couldn't stand up. Mom and Dad ran out of their bedroom. My brother came out too, rubbing his eyes. When he saw the Lego piece, he was {5} that I would be angry. But I just laughed. The next morning, he cleaned up every piece without being told. He even made a small Lego sign for the stairs: "Watch your step!"

blanks.why: the living room floor「客廳的地板」。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
walk down the stairs「走下樓梯」。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能走下去。
fall onto the floor「跌倒在地板上」。cough、fever、lemon 都不能讓人跌在上面。
be in pain「很痛」：踩到樂高痛得站不起來。cough、fever 是生病的症狀，不能用 in so much … 表示「痛」；knee 是身體部位。
be worried that…「擔心…」：弟弟怕我生氣。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。

passages.zh: 我弟弟很愛樂高，每天都在客廳的地板上蓋城堡、汽車和太空船。媽媽總是叫他把積木收好，但他常常忘記。昨天晚上，我半夜醒來想喝水，在黑暗中走下樓梯。走到最下面時，我踩到一個又小又尖的東西。「好痛！」我大叫，跌坐在地上。原來是一塊樂高！我的腳痛到站不起來。爸媽從他們的臥室跑出來，弟弟也揉著眼睛走出來。他看到那塊樂高時，很擔心我會生氣，但我只是笑了。隔天早上，沒有人叫他，他就自己把每一塊積木都收好了，還用樂高做了一個小牌子放在樓梯上：「小心腳步！」

passages.title: 樓梯間的歌聲
passages.text: Amy is the shyest girl in our class. She never speaks loudly. But one day after school, I heard beautiful singing from the {1} behind the library. I walked up quietly and saw Amy. She was sitting on the top step, singing with her eyes closed. Her voice was so clear, and it echoed off the {2}. When she saw me, her face turned red. "Please don't tell anyone," she said. "I'm too {3} to sing in front of people." I promised. Then I asked, "Can I listen sometimes?" She nodded. Every Friday, I sat on the {4} below her and listened. A month later, I helped her sign up for the school singing contest. On the stage, she imagined she was back in the stairwell. She won first place, and the whole hall {5} for her.

blanks.why: singing from the stairs「從樓梯（間）傳來的歌聲」，後面說她坐在最上面一階。coughs、fevers、soups 都沒有台階。
echo off the walls「在牆壁間回響」。coughs、soups、toes 都不會讓聲音反彈產生回音。
too nervous to…「緊張得不敢…」：不敢在別人面前唱歌。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
sit on the floor「坐在地上」聽她唱歌。cough、fever、lemon 都不能坐在上面。
cheer for + 人「為某人歡呼」。fried、boiled、spelled 都不能接 for her 表示喝采。

passages.zh: Amy 是我們班最害羞的女生，說話從來不大聲。可是有一天放學後，我聽見圖書館後面的樓梯間傳來好聽的歌聲。我悄悄走上去，看到 Amy 坐在最上面一階，閉著眼睛唱歌。她的聲音好清亮，在牆壁之間迴盪。她看到我時，臉一下子紅了。「拜託別告訴別人，」她說，「我太緊張了，不敢在別人面前唱歌。」我答應了，接著問：「我可以偶爾來聽嗎？」她點點頭。每個星期五，我都坐在她下方的地上聽她唱。一個月後，我幫她報名了學校的歌唱比賽。站在舞台上時，她想像自己回到了樓梯間。她得了第一名，整個禮堂都為她歡呼。

passages.title: 牆壁太薄的好處
passages.text: The {1} in our old apartment are very thin. Every evening, I can hear our neighbor, Mrs. Chen, teaching English online. At first, it was annoying. I was trying to study in my bedroom, and her voice came right through the {2}. But one night, I started to listen. She was explaining grammar in a fun way, with jokes and examples. I took out my notebook and wrote everything down. After a few weeks, my English grades went up, and my teacher was {3}. One day, I met Mrs. Chen on the {4} and told her the truth. She laughed so hard. "You can just come to my {5} room on Thursday nights," she said. "My students won't mind one more." Now I sit on her sofa every Thursday, and I don't have to listen through the wall anymore.

blanks.why: The walls are very thin「牆壁很薄」，所以聽得到鄰居的聲音。coughs、soups、fevers 都不能說「很薄」、隔開房子。
come through the wall「穿過牆壁傳過來」。cough、toe、soup 都不是隔在兩戶之間的東西。
be surprised「感到驚訝」：老師沒想到我進步這麼多。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
meet … on the stairs「在樓梯上遇到」鄰居。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能站在上面遇到人。
my living room「我家客廳」：可以來客廳上課、坐沙發。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。

passages.zh: 我們家那間舊公寓的牆壁很薄。每天晚上，我都聽得到鄰居陳太太在線上教英文。一開始我覺得很煩，我在臥室念書，她的聲音就直接穿牆傳過來。但有一天晚上，我開始認真聽。她用很有趣的方式講解文法，有笑話也有例句。我拿出筆記本，把內容全都抄下來。幾個星期後，我的英文成績進步了，老師很驚訝。有一天，我在樓梯上遇到陳太太，把實話告訴她。她笑得好大聲。「你星期四晚上直接來我家客廳就好啦，」她說，「我的學生不會介意多一個人。」現在我每個星期四都坐在她家的沙發上，再也不用隔著牆偷聽了。

passages.title: 姐姐的會考餐桌
passages.text: My sister is in ninth grade, and the big exam is coming soon. She doesn't like studying in her bedroom because she always falls asleep on her bed. So every night, she studies at the {1} table. Books and notes cover the whole table, and some even fall on the {2}. Mom has to move them before dinner. On the {3} above the table, my sister put up a big calendar. She crosses off one day every night. The rest of us try to be quiet. Dad turns the TV down in the {4} room, and I don't play games after eight. Last night, I brought her a cup of hot {5} and a cookie. "Thanks," she said. "When the exam is over, I'll take you to the movies." I can't wait!

blanks.why: the dining table「餐桌」：姐姐在餐桌念書。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 table 組成吃飯用的桌子。
fall on the floor「掉到地上」。cough、fever、lemon 都不能讓書掉在上面。
on the wall above the table「餐桌上方的牆上」貼日曆。cough、soup、toe 都不能貼日曆。
in the living room「在客廳」把電視關小聲。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
a cup of hot tea「一杯熱茶」。cough、knee、fever 都不能裝在杯子裡喝。

passages.zh: 我姐姐讀九年級，會考快到了。她不喜歡在臥室念書，因為她總是在床上睡著，所以每天晚上她都在餐桌念書。書和筆記蓋滿了整張桌子，有些甚至掉到地上，媽媽晚餐前還得把它們移開。姐姐在餐桌上方的牆上貼了一張大日曆，每天晚上劃掉一天。我們其他人都盡量保持安靜：爸爸把客廳的電視轉小聲，我八點後也不打電動。昨天晚上，我端了一杯熱茶和一塊餅乾給她。「謝謝，」她說，「等考完，我帶你去看電影。」我等不及了！

passages.title: 卡在樓梯上的沙發
passages.text: Last Saturday, we bought a new sofa for our {1} room. The problem was that we live on the fourth {2}, and there is no elevator. Dad and Uncle Ben carried the big sofa up the {3}. At the first corner, it got stuck. "Turn left! No, right!" Mom shouted. They turned it many times, and it hit the {4} again and again. After an hour, they finally reached our door. But the sofa was too wide to go in! Everyone was {5} and quiet. Then my little brother said, "Why don't you take off the legs?" Dad looked at him, then at the sofa. Five minutes later, the sofa was inside. Dad gave my brother a high five. "You're the smartest one in this family," he said.

blanks.why: a sofa for our living room「放客廳的沙發」。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
live on the fourth floor「住在四樓」：floor 表示樓層。cough、lemon、toe 都不能表示樓層。
carry … up the stairs「把…搬上樓梯」。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能爬上去。
hit the wall「撞到牆」：轉角太窄一直撞牆。soup、cough、fever 都不能被沙發撞到。
be tired「疲倦」：搬了一小時很累。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。

passages.zh: 上星期六，我們買了一張新沙發要放在客廳。問題是我們住在四樓，又沒有電梯。爸爸和 Ben 叔叔把大沙發搬上樓梯，到了第一個轉角就卡住了。「往左轉！不對，往右！」媽媽大喊。他們轉了好多次，沙發一直撞到牆。一個小時後，他們終於到了我們家門口，可是沙發太寬了，進不去！大家都累得說不出話。這時弟弟說：「為什麼不把沙發腳拆下來？」爸爸看看他，又看看沙發。五分鐘後，沙發就搬進屋裡了。爸爸和弟弟擊掌說：「你是我們家最聰明的人。」

passages.title: 客廳裡的聖誕樹
passages.text: Christmas is not a big holiday in Taiwan, but my mom loves it. Every December, she puts a tall Christmas tree in the corner of our {1} room. This year, my sister and I helped her decorate it. We hung red balls, gold stars, and small lights on the tree. We also put colorful paper snowflakes on the {2}. Then Mom baked {3} in the kitchen, and the whole home smelled sweet. On Christmas Eve, we ate dinner at the {4} table by candlelight. After dinner, we sat on the {5} around the tree and opened small presents. My favorite gift was a hand-made card from my little sister. It said, "You are the best sister ever." It doesn't snow in Taiwan, but my heart felt warm.

blanks.why: the living room「客廳」：聖誕樹放在客廳角落。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
put snowflakes on the walls「把雪花貼在牆上」。coughs、soups、fevers 都不能貼東西。
bake cookies「烤餅乾」。coughs、fevers、knees 都不能烤。
the dining table「餐桌」：在燭光下吃晚餐。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 table 組成吃飯用的桌子。
sit on the floor「坐在地上」圍著聖誕樹拆禮物。cough、fever、lemon 都不能坐在上面。

passages.zh: 聖誕節在台灣不算大節日，但我媽媽很喜歡。每年十二月，她都會在客廳的角落放一棵高高的聖誕樹。今年我和妹妹幫她一起裝飾，我們在樹上掛了紅色的球、金色的星星和小燈泡，也在牆上貼了彩色的紙雪花。接著媽媽在廚房烤餅乾，整個家都香香甜甜的。平安夜那天，我們在燭光下圍著餐桌吃晚餐。晚餐後，我們圍著聖誕樹坐在地上，拆小禮物。我最喜歡的禮物是妹妹親手做的卡片，上面寫著：「你是全世界最好的姐姐。」台灣不會下雪，但我的心暖暖的。

passages.title: 阿公家會說話的畫
passages.text: In my grandpa's old house, there is a painting on the {1} of the {2} room. It shows a girl sitting by a river with a cat. One night, I came downstairs to get some water. When I walked past the painting, I saw the cat move its tail! I stopped and looked again. The girl in the painting turned her head and smiled at me. "Don't be {3}," she said. "We only wake up at night." She told me she had lived in the painting for a hundred years. She was lonely, so I sat on the {4} and talked with her until the sun came up. Since then, I visit her every time I stay at Grandpa's. I tell her stories about school, and she tells me about the old days. Grandpa says he doesn't know anything, but last time I found a small cup of {5} next to the painting.

blanks.why: a painting on the wall「牆上的一幅畫」。cough、soup、toe 都不能掛畫。
the living room「客廳」。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
Don't be nervous.「別緊張。」畫裡的女孩安慰我。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
sit on the floor「坐在地上」和她聊天。cough、fever、lemon 都不能坐在上面。
a small cup of tea「一小杯茶」：暗示阿公也知道這個祕密。knee、cough、fever 都不能裝在杯子裡。

passages.zh: 阿公的老房子裡，客廳的牆上掛著一幅畫，畫的是一個女孩帶著一隻貓坐在河邊。有一天晚上，我下樓倒水，經過那幅畫時，看到那隻貓動了一下尾巴！我停下來再看一次，畫裡的女孩轉過頭對我微笑。「別緊張，」她說，「我們只有晚上才會醒來。」她告訴我，她已經在畫裡住了一百年。她很寂寞，所以我坐在地上陪她聊天，一直聊到太陽出來。從那之後，我每次住阿公家都會去找她。我跟她說學校的事，她跟我說以前的故事。阿公說他什麼都不知道，但上一次，我在畫旁邊發現了一小杯茶。

passages.title: 半夜下樓的腳步聲
passages.text: For a week, I heard footsteps on the {1} every night at about one o'clock. Our house has three floors, and my bedroom is on the second {2}, right next to the stairs. Who was going down at midnight? I was too {3} to check. On the eighth night, I took my flashlight and followed the sound. The footsteps went into the kitchen. I heard the fridge door open. Then I saw Grandpa! He was eating a big piece of {4} cake. His doctor had told him to eat less sugar. "Shh," he said. "Don't tell your grandma." I sat down with him at the {5} table. "Grandpa, this isn't good for you," I said. He sighed and gave me the cake. The next day, I bought him some sugar-free cookies. Now we have a secret midnight snack together, and it's a healthy one.

blanks.why: footsteps on the stairs「樓梯上的腳步聲」：有人半夜下樓。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能讓人走在上面。
on the second floor「在二樓」：floor 表示樓層。cough、lemon、toe 都不能表示樓層。
too nervous to check「緊張得不敢去看」。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
chocolate cake「巧克力蛋糕」，醫生要阿公少吃糖。cough、fever、knee 都不能和 cake 組成食物名稱。
the dining table「餐桌」：和阿公一起坐在餐桌旁。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 table 組成吃飯用的桌子。

passages.zh: 有一個星期，我每天晚上一點左右都聽到樓梯上有腳步聲。我們家有三層樓，我的臥室在二樓，就在樓梯旁邊。半夜是誰在下樓？我緊張得不敢去看。第八天晚上，我拿著手電筒跟著聲音走。腳步聲走進了廚房，我聽見冰箱門打開的聲音，接著我看到了阿公！他正在吃一大塊巧克力蛋糕，可是醫生要他少吃糖。「噓，」他說，「別跟你阿嬤說。」我和他一起坐在餐桌旁。「阿公，這對你身體不好。」我說。他嘆了口氣，把蛋糕交給我。隔天，我買了一些無糖餅乾給他。現在我們有了一起吃的祕密宵夜，而且是健康的。

passages.title: 樓梯下的祕密房間
passages.text: My brother Leo is a big fan of Harry Potter. In the first book, Harry lives in a tiny room under the {1}, and Leo thinks it's the coolest bedroom ever. Our house has a small closet under the stairs too. We used to keep old shoes in it. Last summer, Leo asked Mom, "Can I make it my secret room?" Mom said yes. He cleaned it out, put a soft blanket on the {2}, and hung a map of Hogwarts on the {3}. He even made a sign: "Leo's Room. No Muggles!" Every evening, he reads in there with a flashlight. Last night, Mom called him for dinner three times. Finally, he came out to the {4} room with a stick in his hand. "Sorry," he said, "I was busy practicing magic." We all laughed, and Dad said, "Then please use magic to wash the {5} after dinner."

blanks.why: a room under the stairs「樓梯下的房間」。coughs、fevers、soups 下面不會有房間。
put a blanket on the floor「在地上鋪毯子」。cough、fever、lemon 都不能鋪毯子。
hang a map on the wall「把地圖掛在牆上」。soup、cough、toe 都不能掛地圖。
the dining room「飯廳」：媽媽叫他來吃晚餐。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
wash the bowls「洗碗」。coughs、fevers、knees 都不是晚餐後要洗的餐具。

passages.zh: 我弟弟 Leo 是哈利波特的超級粉絲。在第一集裡，哈利住在樓梯下一個小小的房間，Leo 覺得那是全世界最酷的臥室。我們家的樓梯下面也有一個小儲藏櫃，以前用來放舊鞋子。去年暑假，Leo 問媽媽：「我可以把它變成我的祕密房間嗎？」媽媽答應了。他把裡面清空，在地上鋪了一條軟軟的毯子，在牆上掛了一張霍格華茲的地圖，還做了一個牌子：「Leo 的房間，麻瓜止步！」每天晚上，他都拿著手電筒在裡面看書。昨天晚上，媽媽叫他吃晚餐叫了三次，他終於拿著一根棍子走到飯廳。「抱歉，」他說，「我在忙著練魔法。」我們都笑了，爸爸說：「那晚餐後請用魔法洗碗吧。」

passages.title: 爸爸打蠟的地板
passages.text: Last Sunday, Dad decided to wax the {1} in our {2} room. He moved the sofa and the table away, and then he spread the wax carefully. When he finished, the floor was so shiny that I could see my face in it. "Nobody walks here for two hours," he said. But our dog Lucky didn't understand. She ran down the {3}, slipped, and slid all the way across the room. She hit the {4} softly and sat there with a surprised face. We all laughed so hard. Then my little brother wanted to try. He took off his socks and slid like a skater. Mom shook her head, but soon she was sliding too! In the end, the whole family played on the floor for an hour, and Dad had to wax it again. Still, he looked very {5}.

blanks.why: wax the floor「幫地板打蠟」。cough、fever、lemon 都不能打蠟。
the living room「客廳」：移開沙發和桌子。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
run down the stairs「跑下樓梯」。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能跑下來。
hit the wall「撞到牆」：小狗滑過整個房間撞到牆。cough、soup、toe 都不是房間的邊。
look satisfied「看起來很滿意」：雖然要重打蠟，全家玩得很開心。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。

passages.zh: 上星期天，爸爸決定幫客廳的地板打蠟。他把沙發和桌子移開，然後小心地把蠟塗開。打完之後，地板亮到我可以在上面看見自己的臉。「兩個小時內誰都不准走這裡。」他說。可是我們家的狗 Lucky 聽不懂，她從樓梯跑下來，腳一滑，一路滑過整個客廳，輕輕撞到牆，然後一臉驚訝地坐在那裡。我們全都笑翻了。接著弟弟也想試試，他脫掉襪子，像溜冰選手一樣滑來滑去。媽媽搖搖頭，但沒多久她也跟著滑了起來！最後全家在地板上玩了一個小時，爸爸只好重新打一次蠟。不過，他看起來還是很滿意。

passages.title: 母親節的家庭餐廳
passages.text: For Mother's Day, my sister and I turned our {1} room into a restaurant. We named it "Café Mom." First, we cleaned the {2} and put a white cloth on the table. Then we hung paper flowers on the {3}. My sister wrote a {4} by hand: tomato soup, fried rice, and strawberry ice cream. I was the waiter, and she was the cook. When Mom and Dad came down the {5}, I bowed and said, "Welcome! Table for two?" They laughed and sat down. The fried rice was a little salty, and the ice cream melted fast, but Mom said it was the best restaurant in town. At the end, Dad asked for the bill. My sister gave him a piece of paper. It said, "Price: one big hug." Dad paid right away, and Mom gave us two.

blanks.why: the dining room「飯廳」，變成一家餐廳。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
clean the floor「把地板打掃乾淨」。cough、fever、lemon 都不能打掃。
hang flowers on the wall「在牆上掛紙花」。cough、soup、toe 都不能掛東西。
write a menu「寫菜單」，後面列出菜名。cough、knee、fever 都不能寫上菜名。
come down the stairs「走下樓梯」。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能走下來。

passages.zh: 母親節那天，我和妹妹把我們家的飯廳變成了一家餐廳，取名叫「媽媽小館」。我們先把地板打掃乾淨，在桌上鋪了一塊白布，再在牆上掛了紙花。妹妹親手寫了一份菜單：番茄湯、炒飯和草莓冰淇淋。我當服務生，她當廚師。爸媽走下樓梯時，我鞠躬說：「歡迎光臨！兩位嗎？」他們笑著坐下。炒飯有點鹹，冰淇淋也融化得很快，但媽媽說這是全城最棒的餐廳。最後爸爸要結帳，妹妹給他一張紙，上面寫著：「價格：一個大大的擁抱。」爸爸馬上就付了，媽媽則給了我們兩個擁抱。

passages.title: 樓梯間的王奶奶
passages.text: Every morning at seven, I walk down the {1} of our apartment building to go to school. And every morning, I meet Grandma Wang from the third {2}. She is eighty years old, but she walks up and down the stairs every day for exercise. "Good morning! Did you eat breakfast?" she always asks. One week, I didn't see her. I was {3}. I knocked on her door, and her son told me she was in the hospital with the flu. After school, I made a card and drew a picture of the two of us on the stairs. Her son put it on the {4} next to her hospital bed. Two weeks later, I heard a familiar voice on the stairs: "Good morning! Did you eat breakfast?" Grandma Wang was back! She invited me into her {5} room and gave me a big bag of oranges.

blanks.why: walk down the stairs「走下樓梯」。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能走下去。
from the third floor「住三樓的」：floor 表示樓層。cough、lemon、toe 都不能表示樓層。
be worried「擔心」：一星期沒見到王奶奶。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
put it on the wall「把卡片貼在牆上」。cough、soup、toe 都不能貼卡片。
her living room「她家客廳」。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。

passages.zh: 每天早上七點，我都會走下我們公寓大樓的樓梯去上學，而每天早上，我都會遇到住在三樓的王奶奶。她八十歲了，但每天都爬上爬下樓梯來運動。「早安！吃早餐了沒？」她總是這樣問。有一個星期，我都沒看到她，我很擔心。我去敲她家的門，她兒子告訴我她得了流感住院了。放學後，我做了一張卡片，畫了我們兩個在樓梯上的樣子。她兒子把卡片貼在她病床旁邊的牆上。兩個星期後，我在樓梯上聽到一個熟悉的聲音：「早安！吃早餐了沒？」王奶奶回來了！她請我進她家客廳，還送我一大袋柳丁。

passages.title: 停在六點十五分的時鐘
passages.text: The old clock on our kitchen {1} has worked for twenty years. But last Monday morning, it stopped at 6:15, and nobody noticed. I woke up, looked at it, and thought I had lots of time. I ate breakfast slowly at the {2} table and even watched cartoons in the {3} room. When I finally checked my phone, it was 7:40! I ran up the {4}, put on my uniform, and rushed out the door. I got to school ten minutes late, and my teacher was not happy. That evening, Dad took down the clock and put in a new battery. "It's not the clock's fault," he said. "It's just {5}, like you on Monday mornings." Now I always check my phone too.

blanks.why: the clock on the kitchen wall「廚房牆上的時鐘」。cough、soup、toe 都不能掛時鐘。
the dining table「餐桌」：坐在餐桌慢慢吃早餐。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 table 組成吃飯用的桌子。
the living room「客廳」：在客廳看卡通。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
run up the stairs「跑上樓梯」回房間換制服。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能跑上去。
It's just tired.「它只是累了。」把時鐘當成人來說，和星期一早上的我一樣。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物，不能和 like you 比較。

passages.zh: 我們家廚房牆上的那個舊時鐘已經走了二十年，可是上星期一早上，它停在六點十五分，卻沒有人發現。我起床看了一眼，以為時間還很多，就坐在餐桌慢慢吃早餐，甚至還到客廳看了卡通。等我終於看手機時，已經七點四十分了！我跑上樓梯，換上制服，衝出家門。我到學校時遲到了十分鐘，老師很不高興。那天晚上，爸爸把時鐘拿下來換了新電池。「這不是時鐘的錯，」他說，「它只是累了，就像星期一早上的你一樣。」現在我也一定會看手機確認時間。

passages.title: 客廳變舞池
passages.text: Last Saturday was Grandpa and Grandma's fiftieth wedding anniversary. They didn't want a big party, so we had a small one at home. We moved the sofa and the table to the side of the {1} room. Then we hung colorful lights on the {2}. My uncle played an old love song, and Grandpa held out his hand to Grandma. "May I have this dance?" he asked. They danced slowly in the middle of the {3}. Grandma's face turned pink, and everyone clapped. Then the music changed to a fast pop song. My little cousin pulled me up, and soon the whole family was dancing. Even Dad, who never dances, joined in. Later, we ate cake at the {4} table. Grandma said it was the best anniversary ever. Grandpa smiled and looked very {5}.

blanks.why: the living room「客廳」：把沙發桌子推到旁邊空出舞池。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
hang lights on the walls「在牆上掛燈」。coughs、soups、fevers 都不能掛燈。
in the middle of the floor「在地板（舞池）中間」跳舞。cough、fever、lemon 都不能在中間跳舞。
the dining table「餐桌」：在餐桌吃蛋糕。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 table 組成吃飯用的桌子。
look satisfied「看起來很滿足」。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。

passages.zh: 上星期六是爺爺奶奶結婚五十週年紀念日。他們不想辦大派對，所以我們在家裡辦了一個小小的慶祝會。我們把沙發和桌子推到客廳旁邊，在牆上掛了彩色的燈。叔叔放了一首老情歌，爺爺向奶奶伸出手：「可以請妳跳支舞嗎？」他們在地板中央慢慢地跳著舞，奶奶的臉都紅了，大家都拍手。接著音樂換成快節奏的流行歌，小表妹把我拉起來，很快地全家人都跳起舞來，連從來不跳舞的爸爸也加入了。後來我們在餐桌吃蛋糕，奶奶說這是最棒的一次紀念日。爺爺笑著，看起來非常滿足。

passages.title: 牆上的世界地圖
passages.text: In our {1} room, there is a big world map on the {2}. Every time someone in our family visits a new country, we put a red pin on it. Dad has been to Japan, Korea, and Thailand for work. Mom went to France before she got married. I have only been to Japan. Last year, my sister studied in Australia for a month, so she put a pin on Sydney. One night, we all sat on the {3} in front of the map and talked about our dream trips. Dad wants to see the northern lights in Iceland. My sister wants to visit the pyramids in Egypt, and I want to watch a soccer game in Spain. So we started a "travel box" on the {4} table. Every week, we put some {5} in it. Maybe in a few years, we will need many more red pins.

blanks.why: the living room「客廳」：地圖掛在客廳。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
a map on the wall「牆上的地圖」。cough、soup、toe 都不能掛地圖。
sit on the floor「坐在地上」看地圖聊天。cough、fever、lemon 都不能坐在上面。
on the dining table「在餐桌上」放旅行存錢箱。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 table 組成餐桌。
put coins in it「把硬幣放進去」存旅費。coughs、fevers、knees 都不能存起來。

passages.zh: 我們家客廳的牆上掛著一張大大的世界地圖。家裡只要有人去了一個新的國家，我們就在上面插一根紅色圖釘。爸爸因為工作去過日本、韓國和泰國，媽媽結婚前去過法國，我只去過日本。去年姐姐到澳洲讀了一個月的書，所以她在雪梨插了一根圖釘。有一天晚上，我們全家坐在地圖前的地上，聊我們夢想中的旅行。爸爸想去冰島看北極光，姐姐想去埃及看金字塔，我想去西班牙看足球賽。於是我們在餐桌上放了一個「旅行箱」，每個星期都放一些硬幣進去。也許過幾年，我們就需要更多紅色圖釘了。

passages.title: 睡地板的夏天
passages.text: This summer was the hottest one I can remember. One night in July, the air conditioner in my bedroom broke. My room was like an oven, and I couldn't sleep at all. At midnight, I took my pillow and went down the {1}. The {2} room was a little cooler, so I lay down on the {3}. The tiles were cold and smooth, and it felt wonderful. Soon, I heard footsteps. It was my brother with his pillow. Then my sister came, and finally even our dog joined us. In the morning, Mom found all of us asleep in a line by the {4}. She laughed, took a photo, and made cold mango {5} for our breakfast. The air conditioner was fixed three days later, but my brother and I still sleep on the floor sometimes, just for fun.

blanks.why: go down the stairs「走下樓梯」。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能走下去。
the living room「客廳」比較涼。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
lie down on the floor「躺在地板上」，下一句說磁磚冰冰的。cough、fever、lemon 都不能躺在上面。
by the wall「靠著牆邊」排成一排睡。cough、soup、toe 都不能讓人睡在旁邊排成一排。
mango juice「芒果汁」。cough、fever、knee 都不能和 mango 組成飲料。

passages.zh: 今年夏天是我記憶中最熱的一個夏天。七月的某個晚上，我房間的冷氣壞了，房間熱得像烤箱，我完全睡不著。半夜，我抱著枕頭走下樓梯。客廳比較涼一點，所以我躺在地板上。磁磚冰涼又光滑，感覺好舒服。沒多久，我聽到腳步聲，是哥哥抱著枕頭來了。接著姐姐也來了，最後連我們家的狗也加入了。早上，媽媽發現我們全都靠著牆邊排成一排睡著了。她笑著拍了一張照片，然後做了冰芒果汁給我們當早餐。三天後冷氣修好了，但我和哥哥有時候還是會睡在地板上，只是因為好玩。

passages.title: 爸爸改爬樓梯
passages.text: Dad's doctor told him he needed more exercise. Dad works on the twelfth {1} of a tall building, so he decided to take the {2} instead of the elevator. On the first day, he came home and lay on the {3} room sofa for an hour. "My legs are dead," he said. On the second day, he had to stop and rest on the sixth floor. But he didn't give up. Every evening, he wrote his time on a paper on the {4} next to the fridge. After a month, he could climb all twelve floors in five minutes. He also lost four kilograms. Last week, his doctor was very {5}. Now the whole family takes the stairs in our building, even my little sister. She says she wants to beat Dad's time one day.

blanks.why: on the twelfth floor「在十二樓」：floor 表示樓層。cough、lemon、toe 都不能表示樓層。
take the stairs「走樓梯」，和 take the elevator（搭電梯）相對。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能「搭」或「走」。
the living room sofa「客廳的沙發」。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
a paper on the wall「貼在牆上的紙」記錄時間。cough、soup、toe 都不能貼紙。
be surprised「感到驚訝」：醫生沒想到他進步這麼多。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。

passages.zh: 爸爸的醫生說他需要多運動。爸爸在一棟高樓的十二樓上班，所以他決定不搭電梯，改走樓梯。第一天，他回到家就在客廳的沙發上躺了一個小時。「我的腿廢了。」他說。第二天，他爬到六樓就得停下來休息。但他沒有放棄，每天晚上，他都把自己爬樓梯的時間寫在冰箱旁牆上的一張紙上。一個月後，他五分鐘就能爬完十二層樓，還瘦了四公斤。上星期，他的醫生非常驚訝。現在我們全家在自己住的大樓都走樓梯，連妹妹也是。她說總有一天要打破爸爸的紀錄。

passages.title: 牆上的星空
passages.text: My little sister is afraid of the dark. Every night, she asks Mom to leave the light on, and she can't fall asleep easily. For her birthday, I saved my pocket money and bought her a star projector. That night, I turned off the light in her bedroom and turned on the projector. Suddenly, thousands of stars appeared on the {1}. Blue and purple stars moved slowly across the room and even across the {2}. My sister's eyes opened wide. She was so {3} that she couldn't say a word. Then she whispered, "It's like sleeping in space!" Ten minutes later, she was asleep. I walked quietly down the {4} to the {5} room. "How did it go?" Mom asked. I smiled. "She's sleeping like a baby." Now my sister isn't afraid of the dark anymore. In fact, she turns off the light herself so she can see her stars.

blanks.why: stars appeared on the walls「星星出現在牆上」。coughs、soups、fevers 都不能投影星星。
across the floor「滑過地板」，星星連地上都有。cough、fever、lemon 都不是房間的一部分。
so surprised that…「驚訝到說不出話」。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
walk down the stairs「走下樓梯」。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能走下去。
the living room「客廳」：媽媽在客廳等著問結果。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。

passages.zh: 我妹妹很怕黑，每天晚上都要媽媽留一盞燈，而且很難睡著。她生日時，我存了零用錢，買了一台星空投影機給她。那天晚上，我關掉她臥室的燈，打開投影機。突然間，成千上萬顆星星出現在牆上，藍色和紫色的星星慢慢地滑過整個房間，連地板上也有。妹妹的眼睛睜得大大的，驚訝得說不出話來。接著她小聲說：「好像睡在太空裡！」十分鐘後，她就睡著了。我輕輕地走下樓梯到客廳。「怎麼樣？」媽媽問。我笑著說：「她睡得像個小寶寶。」現在妹妹不再怕黑了，事實上，她還會自己關燈，好看見她的星星。

passages.title: 飛進客廳的綠繡眼
passages.text: One afternoon, I left the window open and went to the kitchen to get a snack. When I came back to the {1} room, there was a little bird on top of the TV! It was green and yellow, and it looked very scared. It flew around the room and hit the {2} twice. I didn't want it to get hurt, so I turned off the fan and stayed still. Then I put some rice on a {3} by the open window. The bird landed on the {4} and looked at me for a long time. My little brother ran down the {5} and asked, "What happened?" I put my finger to my lips. The bird slowly jumped to the plate, ate a few grains, and flew out of the window. "A bird came to visit us," I told my brother. "It even stayed for lunch."

blanks.why: the living room「客廳」：小鳥停在電視上。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
hit the wall「撞到牆」。cough、soup、toe 都不能被鳥撞到。
put rice on a plate「把米放在盤子上」。cough、fever、knee 都不能放米。
land on the floor「降落在地上」。cough、fever、lemon 都不能讓鳥停在上面看我。
run down the stairs「跑下樓梯」。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能跑下來。

passages.zh: 有一天下午，我開著窗戶，去廚房拿點心。回到客廳時，電視上竟然停著一隻小鳥！牠是黃綠色的，看起來很害怕。牠在房間裡飛來飛去，撞到牆兩次。我不想讓牠受傷，就關掉電風扇，站著不動。接著我在打開的窗戶旁放了一個盤子，上面放了一些米。小鳥降落在地上，看了我好久。弟弟從樓梯跑下來問：「發生什麼事？」我把手指放在嘴唇上。小鳥慢慢跳到盤子上，吃了幾粒米，然後從窗戶飛走了。「有隻鳥來拜訪我們，」我跟弟弟說，「牠還留下來吃了午餐呢。」

passages.title: 外婆家的大圓桌
passages.text: Every Lunar New Year's Eve, our whole family goes to Grandma's house in Chiayi. There are twenty of us, so Grandma puts a big round table in the middle of the {1} room. She cooks for two days before the dinner. There is chicken soup, fish, {2}, and her famous braised pork. The kids sit on small chairs, and some even sit on the {3} when there are not enough seats. After dinner, Grandpa gives each of us a red envelope. Then everyone moves to the {4} room to play cards and watch TV. On the {5}, there is a photo of every New Year's dinner since 1990. This year, we took a new one. Grandma looked at all the photos and said, "Every year, the table gets more crowded. That's the best gift for me."

blanks.why: the dining room「飯廳」：圓桌放在飯廳中間。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
dumplings「水餃」，和雞湯、魚、滷肉並列為年菜。coughs、fevers、knees 都不能吃。
sit on the floor「坐在地上」：椅子不夠。cough、fever、lemon 都不能坐在上面。
the living room「客廳」：飯後到客廳打牌看電視。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
photos on the wall「牆上的照片」。cough、soup、toe 都不能掛照片。

passages.zh: 每年除夕，我們全家都會到外婆在嘉義的家。我們一共有二十個人，所以外婆會在飯廳中間放一張大圓桌。她在年夜飯前要煮兩天：有雞湯、魚、水餃，還有她最拿手的滷肉。小孩坐在小椅子上，椅子不夠時，有些人甚至坐在地上。吃完飯，外公會發紅包給每個人，接著大家移到客廳打牌、看電視。牆上掛著從 1990 年以來每一年的年夜飯照片，今年我們又拍了一張新的。外婆看著所有照片說：「每一年，這張桌子都越來越擠，這就是我最好的禮物。」

passages.title: 在樓梯上扭到腳
passages.text: Last Wednesday, I was late for basketball practice, so I ran down the {1} of the school building two steps at a time. Suddenly, my foot slipped. I fell and landed on the {2} at the bottom. My ankle hurt so much that I couldn't stand up. My classmate ran to get the school {3}. She checked my foot and put ice on it. "It's not broken," she said, "but you can't play basketball for two weeks." I was very {4} because we had a big game that weekend. At home, I had to stay on the sofa in the {5} room. My brother brought me snacks and comic books. On the day of the game, I sat with the team and cheered. We won! And I learned an important lesson: never run on the stairs.

blanks.why: run down the stairs「跑下樓梯」。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能跑下去。
land on the floor「摔在地上」。cough、lemon、soup 都不能讓人摔在上面。
the school nurse「學校護理師」：受傷要找保健室護理師。cough、lemon、fever 都不是人，不能被叫來幫忙。
be disappointed「失望」：不能參加週末的大比賽。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
the living room「客廳」：在客廳沙發上休息。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。

passages.zh: 上星期三，我籃球練習快遲到了，所以在學校大樓的樓梯上一次跨兩階往下跑。突然，我的腳一滑，摔倒在樓梯底下的地上。我的腳踝痛到站不起來。同學跑去找學校的護理師，她檢查了我的腳，幫我冰敷。「沒有骨折，」她說，「但你兩個星期不能打籃球。」我非常失望，因為那個週末我們有一場大比賽。在家時，我只能待在客廳的沙發上，哥哥拿點心和漫畫給我。比賽那天，我坐在隊友旁邊加油。我們贏了！而我也學到很重要的一課：絕對不要在樓梯上奔跑。

passages.title: 多出來的第十四階
passages.text: Our house has thirteen steps from the first {1} to the second. I know because I count them every day. But one night, when I went up the {2} to bed, I counted fourteen. I stopped and counted again. Fourteen! The new step was at the very top, and it was a different color. I was {3}, but I stepped on it. Suddenly, the {4} in front of me opened like a door. Behind it, there was a long hallway full of old toys: a red kite, a wooden horse, and a doll. A little voice said, "These are all the toys people forgot." I picked up the wooden horse. It was the one I lost when I was five! When I came back, the extra step was gone. The next morning, Mom found me asleep in the {5} room, holding the wooden horse. "Where did you find that?" she asked. I just smiled.

blanks.why: from the first floor to the second「從一樓到二樓」：floor 表示樓層。cough、lemon、toe 都不能表示樓層。
go up the stairs「上樓梯」。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能走上去。
be nervous「緊張」：樓梯多了一階很奇怪。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
the wall opened like a door「牆像門一樣打開」。cough、soup、toe 都不能在面前打開。
the living room「客廳」：隔天早上在客廳被發現。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。

passages.zh: 我們家從一樓到二樓有十三階樓梯，我知道是因為我每天都會數。可是有一天晚上，我上樓睡覺時卻數到十四階。我停下來再數一次，還是十四！新的那一階在最上面，顏色也不一樣。我很緊張，但還是踩了上去。突然，我面前的牆像門一樣打開了。牆後面是一條長長的走廊，擺滿了舊玩具：紅色的風箏、木馬，還有一個洋娃娃。一個小小的聲音說：「這些都是人們忘記的玩具。」我拿起那隻木馬，那是我五歲時弄丟的那一隻！我回來時，多出來的那一階已經不見了。隔天早上，媽媽發現我抱著木馬在客廳睡著了。「你在哪裡找到的？」她問。我只是笑了笑。

passages.title: 在客廳練運球
passages.text: I want to be a better basketball player, so I practice dribbling every day. But it rained all last week, and I couldn't go to the park. So I practiced in our {1} room instead. Bang, bang, bang! The ball hit the {2} again and again. After ten minutes, someone knocked on our door. It was Mr. Lee from downstairs. "My lamp is shaking!" he said. Mom said sorry, and I had to stop. I was {3} because I really wanted to practice. Then Dad had an idea. He put an old yoga mat on the floor and hung a small paper basket on the {4}. "Dribble on the mat and shoot softly," he said. It was much quieter. I also walked up and down the {5} to make my legs stronger. When the rain stopped, I went back to the park. My coach said, "Your dribbling is much better! What did you do?" I laughed. "I trained at home."

blanks.why: practice in our living room「在我們家客廳練習」。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
The ball hit the floor「球打在地板上」，所以樓下聽得到。cough、fever、lemon 都不能讓球拍打。
be upset「不高興」：很想練球卻被迫停下來。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
hang a basket on the wall「在牆上掛籃框」。cough、soup、toe 都不能掛籃框。
walk up and down the stairs「上下走樓梯」練腿力。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能走上走下。

passages.zh: 我想成為更好的籃球選手，所以每天都練運球。可是上星期一直下雨，我沒辦法去公園，只好改在家裡的客廳練。砰、砰、砰！球一次又一次打在地板上。十分鐘後，有人來敲門，是樓下的李先生。「我家的燈在晃！」他說。媽媽向他道歉，我只好停下來。我很不高興，因為我真的很想練球。後來爸爸想到一個辦法：他在地上鋪了一張舊瑜珈墊，在牆上掛了一個紙做的小籃框。「在墊子上運球，投籃輕一點。」他說。這樣安靜多了。我也在樓梯上走上走下，讓腿變得更有力。雨停後，我回到公園。教練說：「你的運球進步好多！你做了什麼？」我笑著說：「我在家裡練的。」

passages.title: 全家玩健身環
passages.text: Last month, Dad bought the game Ring Fit Adventure. You hold a ring and wear a band on your leg, and you exercise to fight monsters in the game. Every night after dinner, we move the table to the side of the {1} room. Then we take turns playing. Mom is the best. She can squat for five minutes without stopping. Dad is always {2} after ten minutes, and he lies on the {3} like a starfish. My little brother jumps so hard that the pictures on the {4} shake. Grandma watches from the {5} table and laughs at all of us. One night, our neighbor downstairs called. We thought she was going to complain, but she asked, "What game is that? I want to buy it too!"

blanks.why: the living room「客廳」：把桌子推開騰出空間。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
be tired「疲倦」：爸爸十分鐘就累了。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物的字。
lie on the floor「躺在地上」。cough、fever、lemon 都不能躺在上面。
the pictures on the wall「牆上的畫（照片）」被震得搖晃。cough、soup、toe 都不能掛畫。
the dining table「餐桌」：阿嬤坐在餐桌旁看。boiling、sneezing、spelling 都不能和 table 組成吃飯用的桌子。

gloss: 健身環大冒險（電玩遊戲）
passages.zh: 上個月，爸爸買了《健身環大冒險》這款遊戲。你要拿著一個環、腿上綁一條帶子，用運動來打敗遊戲裡的怪物。每天晚餐後，我們都把桌子推到客廳旁邊，然後輪流玩。媽媽最厲害，她可以連續深蹲五分鐘都不停。爸爸總是十分鐘就累了，像海星一樣躺在地上。弟弟跳得太用力，連牆上的照片都在晃。阿嬤坐在餐桌旁看著，笑我們每一個人。有一天晚上，樓下的鄰居打電話來，我們以為她要來抱怨，沒想到她問：「那是什麼遊戲？我也想買！」

passages.title: 九份的石階
passages.text: Last weekend, my family took a trip to Jiufen, an old mountain town in New Taipei. The town is famous for its long stone {1} and red lanterns. We climbed up slowly and stopped at many small shops. We ate taro balls and fish ball {2}. Then we went into an old teahouse. Its wooden {3} made noises when we walked. On the {4}, there were old photos of gold miners from a hundred years ago. We sat by the window and drank tea. Outside, the mountains and the sea were covered in fog. Mom said many people think the town looks like a scene from Spirited Away. In the evening, the lanterns were lit, and the whole town became bright and beautiful. By the end of the day, my legs were {5}, but walking down the stairs in the lantern light, I felt like I was in a dream.

blanks.why: stone stairs「石階」：九份以長長的石頭階梯出名。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能用石頭做、讓人爬。
fish ball soup「魚丸湯」。cough、knee、fever 都不能和 fish ball 組成食物。
wooden floor「木頭地板」，走路會發出聲音。cough、lemon、toe 都不能用 wooden 形容、讓人走在上面。
photos on the walls「牆上的照片」。coughs、soups、fevers 都不能掛照片。
my legs were sore「腿很痠」：爬了一整天樓梯。spicy、juicy、crispy 都是形容食物，不能形容腿。

passages.zh: 上週末，我們全家去九份旅行，那是新北市一座山上的老城鎮，以長長的石階和紅燈籠聞名。我們慢慢往上爬，在很多小店停下來，吃了芋圓和魚丸湯。接著我們走進一間老茶館，它的木頭地板走起來會嘎吱作響。牆上掛著一百年前淘金礦工的老照片。我們坐在窗邊喝茶，窗外的山和海都籠罩在霧裡。媽媽說，很多人覺得這個小鎮很像《神隱少女》裡的場景。傍晚時，燈籠亮了，整個小鎮變得明亮又美麗。一天下來，我的腿很痠，但在燈籠的光裡走下石階時，我覺得自己好像在做夢。

passages.title: 不敢下樓梯的小狗
passages.text: Last month, we adopted a small brown puppy named Toffee. Our house has two floors, and Toffee loves running around the {1} room. But she had one problem: she was afraid of the {2}. She could go up, but she couldn't go down. Every night, she sat at the top and cried until someone carried her. My sister searched online for help. We put her favorite dog {3} on each step. Toffee came down one step, ate a cookie, and stopped. The next day, she came down two steps. We cheered for her every time. Mom put a soft mat on the {4} at the bottom, just in case. After two weeks, Toffee ran all the way down by herself. We were so proud of her. Now she runs up and down all day, so we have to keep her cookies on a high shelf on the {5}.

blanks.why: the living room「客廳」：小狗在客廳跑來跑去。frying、coughing、spelling 都不能和 room 組成房間名稱。
be afraid of the stairs「怕樓梯」：會上不會下。coughs、fevers、soups 都不能讓狗爬上爬下。
dog cookies「狗餅乾」，放在每一階引導牠。coughs、fevers、knees 都不能吃。
a mat on the floor「地上的墊子」，以防跌倒。cough、fever、lemon 都不能鋪墊子。
a shelf on the wall「牆上的架子」。cough、soup、toe 都不能裝架子。

passages.zh: 上個月，我們領養了一隻棕色的小狗，名字叫太妃。我們家有兩層樓，太妃很喜歡在客廳跑來跑去，但牠有一個問題：牠怕樓梯。牠爬得上去，卻下不來。每天晚上，牠都坐在樓梯最上面哭，直到有人把牠抱下來。姐姐上網找方法，我們在每一階都放上牠最愛的狗餅乾。太妃走下一階，吃了一塊餅乾就停住了。第二天，牠走下了兩階。每一次我們都為牠歡呼。媽媽還在樓梯底下的地上鋪了軟墊，以防萬一。兩個星期後，太妃自己一路跑下來了，我們都好以牠為榮。現在牠整天跑上跑下，所以我們得把牠的餅乾放在牆上高高的架子上。
